scenarios.name: nominal
scenarios.operator_lesson: Use settled stationary windows across both signs of roll and pitch; stop capture before every repositioning movement.

scenarios.name: gyro_motion
scenarios.operator_lesson: Any movement during a gyro window contaminates the electronic-bias estimate; stop capture before touching the robot.

scenarios.name: gyro_warmup
scenarios.operator_lesson: Let the powered sensor reach thermal stability before gyro capture; the full capture must span less than 1 C.

scenarios.name: accelerometer_limited_tilt
scenarios.operator_lesson: Yaw-only or nearly level poses cannot distinguish accelerometer bias from gravity magnitude; use varied positive and negative roll and pitch.

scenarios.name: accelerometer_repositioning
scenarios.operator_lesson: Capture only after the robot has settled at each accelerometer pose; exclude all repositioning motion.

scenarios.name: magnetometer_short_arc
scenarios.operator_lesson: Complete a slow circle exceeding 300 degrees; a partial turn does not constrain the planar hard-iron fit.

scenarios.name: magnetometer_tilt
scenarios.operator_lesson: Keep roll and pitch nearly constant during the horizontal circle; large tilt variation invalidates the planar model.

scenarios.name: magnetometer_interference
scenarios.operator_lesson: Keep movable ferrous objects and changing high-current fields away; repeat captures must see the same field.

scenarios.name: gravity_motion
scenarios.operator_lesson: For the gravity report, use one final installed pose and wait until all handling vibration has stopped.
